## Before and after

Before: Describe the previous behaviour and the problem it caused.

After: Describe the resulting behaviour and the scope of this change.

## Verification

State which checks ran and their results. Link useful evidence. Say when a check
was not run or is still failing.

## Real-surface proof

Name the build and surface exercised, the user actions taken and the observed
result. Distinguish recordings, simulations and direct observation. State what
remains unproved. For documentation-only changes, explain why this is unnecessary.

## Code review

Give the reviewer and outcome. Briefly record important findings, their resolution
and anything still blocking acceptance. Keep detailed review history in its owner.

## Known limitations

List material limitations, unproved behaviour and necessary follow-up. State when
there are none known.
